about: The Electron fuse set of ADR-019 item 5 per build target, as spike S-019-2 recorded it on the wire of every release-target artifact (electron-builder 26.15.3, Electron 44; packaging lane run 39205769685). scripts/release/fuses.mjs flips it in afterPack and P-01 (scripts/release/packaged/p01-fuses.packaged.mjs) reads it back from each packaged artifact. RunAsNode stays enabled: the Host runs the app executable with ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE (ADR-002 D1). A known limit with flipped true is still asserted on the wire; one with flipped false is a fuse the target cannot flip, so P-01 asserts every other fuse there. Known limits go to the release notes (R-16).

knownLimits.limit: No Linux artifact (AppImage, deb) embeds an asar integrity record, so the fuse is on but has nothing to validate: a modified app.asar is not detected on Linux (S-019-2).
